name: GitHub Copilot SDK — via Foundry project endpoint
summary: Copilot SDK BYOK provider pointed at the Foundry project /openai/v1/ URL with a `{conn}/{model}` BYOM prefix in the model field.
description: The GitHub Copilot SDK (github/copilot-sdk) supports BYOK against OpenAI-compatible endpoints. If you point it at the Foundry **project-level** endpoint (`{project_endpoint}/openai/v1/`) and pass `model="{apim-conn}/{deployment}"`, Foundry should parse the prefix and route to the APIM connection the same way it does for direct Responses API calls. Auth path is static-credential only (`apiKey` or `bearerToken`), so Entra flows require a caller-managed refresh loop.
notes:
Not yet probed end-to-end against Foundry. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/how-to/develop/sdk-auth; sample: https://github.com/github/copilot-sdk/blob/main/docs/auth/byok.md. See `test.py` for the Copilot session against `{project_endpoint}/openai/v1/` with `wire_model='{connection}/{deployment}'`.

Endpoint gotcha: the `byok.md` sample uses `https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/`, which is the account-level AOAI endpoint and cannot see Foundry connections; BYOM prefixes 404 there. Use `https://<account>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project>/openai/v1/`, `wire_api: 'responses'`, and `bearer_token_provider` so Entra tokens refresh on every request.
